title: Pre-registered transfer test of the retrieval-window law on deployed checkpoints, with frozen predictions from p2c's fitted instrument
one_line: p2c characterized the instrument (G3 fitted, so not quotable as a prediction). p2d freezes p2c's fitted boundary + measured residual into per-stratum predictions BEFORE any probe is scored, evaluates them on FRESH draws (new salt, new filler region, new probe positions), and adds two arms the fit never touched: phi3 with the window FORCED to 1024 (unseen boundary — pure arithmetic extrapolation) and mistral-v0.1 with the window DISABLED (predicts the cliff vanishes on the same weights).
authority: SUCCESSOR-DIRECTIVE.md in p2c's campaign dir (interactive session, Hani-approved 2026-08-02); designed and launched by the operator as p2-lineage owner per COORDINATION.md rule 6.

instrument.frozen_from: p2c's run_p2c.py exactly: value-token distance anchor, strict digit-boundary scoring, structural G1 via the sliding/causal mask builders, BOS prepended, decorrelated filler offsets, per-stratum OOM robustness. No further fitting of any kind.
changes_from_p2c_are_evaluation_draws_on: eval RNG seed 3379290924 (fresh 4-byte salt, sha256 eac71d3a3697af79be05e81c5bfeb8798f7ca59928233579804d981ebcaef36c, in eval_salt.txt)
filler pool from a fresh corpus region (train.bin offset 600000, disjoint from p2c's 300000..560000)
per-stratum random base offset for probe placement (spacing guarantee kept)
new arms 3-4 via --force-window / --disable-window on the same loader path

arms.role: UNSEEN boundary: config.sliding_window forced to 1024 on the same weights; no fit ever saw this boundary. Mask arithmetic verified pre-launch: builder returns max_attendable_distance=1023.
counterfactual: window disabled on the same weights; the law predicts the cliff VANISHES. Strata identical to arm 2 for direct comparison.

frozen_predictions.basis: b = p2c's structural boundary (max attendable distance W-1); every stratum is >=48 tokens from the boundary so no stratum is ambiguous. r_resid recomputed 2026-08-02 00:35Z from p2c artifacts (probes at d >= W+48): phi3 672 probes -> 0.0298; mistral_v01 672 probes -> 0.0238.
frozen_predictions.per_stratum_rule: predicted recall = 1.0 for strata below the arm's boundary, r_resid for strata above it; arm 4 predicts 1.0 at ALL strata.

arm_phi3_w1024.note: r_resid borrowed from phi3's fitted far-field — the extrapolation under test

preregistered_gates.G0_capability: strict recall >= 0.90 at all strata d <= 256. Failure => INCONCLUSIVE for that arm (not a law failure).
preregistered_gates.G1_structural: windowed arms: create_sliding_window_causal_mask returns a materialized mask with max_attendable_distance == W-1 (exclusive convention, read off the mask). Arm 4: create_causal_mask returns full causal visibility (max_attendable_distance == n-1). Unreachable/None/other => VOID for that arm, no behavioural fallback.
preregistered_gates.GP_prediction: per-stratum |observed - predicted| <= 0.05 on >= 20 of 24 strata. Tolerance rationale: binomial sd at n=48, p~0.03 is ~0.025, so 0.05 ~ 2sd; expected marginal misses ~1 per arm, K=20 leaves 4x headroom without letting a real deviation through.
preregistered_gates.GB_boundary: windowed arms: the largest stratum with recall >= 0.90 is the last pre-boundary stratum AND the first post-boundary stratum has recall <= r_resid + 0.10. Arm 4: recall >= 0.90 at EVERY stratum (boundary absent).
preregistered_gates.pass_if: G0 and G1 and GP and GB, per arm independently. Strata that OOM-truncate are excluded from GP's denominator with K scaled as ceil(20/24 * n_completed); GB must still be evaluable (boundary strata completed) or the arm is INCONCLUSIVE.

interpretation_fixed_in_advance.arms_1_2_3_pass: LAW_ARITHMETIC_TRANSFERS: frozen predictions hold on deployed checkpoints, including a boundary no fit ever saw. This earns the sentence the directive names.
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.arms_1_2_pass_3_fails: TRANSFERS_ON_FITTED_BOUNDARIES_ONLY: the instrument certifies seen configurations but does not extrapolate; report which side (fail-high/fail-low) arm 3 missed on.
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.arm_1_or_2_fails: PREDICTIONS_DO_NOT_HOLD: p2c's characterization does not survive fresh draws; p2b's LAW_DOES_NOT_TRANSFER stands unhedged and p2c is demoted to a one-sample description.
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.arm_4_fails_with_cliff: CONFOUND_ALERT: a cliff that survives mask removal is not caused by the mask; every windowed-arm interpretation above is suspended pending diagnosis, notify Hani.
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.fail_high_convention: observed > predicted at out-strata = the law UNDER-promises residual recall (provisioning by it stays conservative — commercially survivable branch, per the directive).
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.fail_low_convention: observed < predicted at in-strata = in-window saturation violated = the law OVER-promises; the commercially dangerous branch, must be reported prominently.
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.note: Fixed 2026-08-02 00:40Z, before any p2d probe was scored. No gate may be amended after launch; instrument crash-robustness fixes that do not touch scoring or gates are permitted and logged, per the p2c precedent.

execution.hardware: 4x local V100, one arm per GPU, evaluation only, models already in HF cache, no cloud spend, no training seeds consumed
execution.controls: matched-regime no-needle controls every 4th probe at every stratum, generations retained (p2c FIX 3)
execution.alloc: PYTORCH_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True on all arms (p2c mistral OOM lesson)
